title: Builld
subtitle: Product studio — fast-track ideas into reality
description: A product studio platform designed to fast-track ideas into reality. Builld provides the infrastructure, tools, and methodology for quickly prototyping, building, and launching digital products.
problem: Many promising product ideas never reach market because the gap between concept and launch is too wide. Founders and teams need a structured approach to rapidly prototype, validate, and ship digital products.
role: Designed and built the platform infrastructure, established the development methodology, and created the tools for rapid product iteration from concept to deployment.
approach: Platform approach to product development — standardized templates, deployment pipelines, and validation frameworks that reduce the time from idea to live product. Built with modern web technologies and cloud-native architecture.
hardestDecision: Creating a system that's flexible enough to accommodate different product types while maintaining enough structure to actually speed up development — too rigid and it limits creativity, too loose and it doesn't provide value.
outcome: Live at builld.tech, serving as the foundation for rapid product development.
whatIdChange: Would add AI-assisted product scoping, implement automated testing templates for each product type, and build a community showcase of products built with the platform.
